parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/domain/errors.ts only defines a hierarchy of domain error types: an abstract DomainError plus ValidationError, NotFoundError, InsufficientStockError and InvalidTransitionError. Each one carries a symbolic code and data about the business situation, such as productId, requested and available stock. Nothing in the file handles persistence, transport or frameworks. The codes are plain domain strings, not HTTP statuses, and there is no serialization or mapping to responses. Turning these errors into transport responses is presumably done in src/infrastructure/http.ts, which is the right layer for it. Describing domain failures is a proper job for the domain layer.
